subject: Brightline Health — Kickoff: confirm attendees, agenda & meeting link
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Susan Kim <susan.kim@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Brightline Health — Kickoff: confirm attendees, agenda & meeting link

Hi Susan —

Thanks for agreeing to a kickoff. To make the session useful for both sides, below are two time options and a draft agenda. Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend (we'll add the calendar invite once we have final attendees).

Proposed times (PT):
- Option A: Thu, Feb 19 — 10:00–11:00 PT (1:00–2:00 ET)
- Option B: Thu, Feb 19 — 13:00–14:00 PT (4:00–5:00 ET)

Draft agenda (45–60 min):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10 min) — Alex + Marissa
2) Product overview & architecture map (15 min) — Vivek
3) Implementation plan & milestones (15 min) — Alex/Monica
4) Questions, next steps & action items (10 min)

Suggested attendees (Redwood): Alex (AM — lead), Marissa (CS lead), Vivek (Solutions Engineer), Monica (AE/PM).
Suggested attendees (Brightline): Project manager, Engineering lead, Security/compliance contact, Procurement (if you want contract questions on the call).

Attachments: Brightline_Kickoff_Agenda.pdf (draft) — contains objectives and milestone table.

If you prefer a slightly different agenda or need a working session for SSO/infra, flag it and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

--

Thanks for the clear options and agenda. Option A (10:00 PT / 1:00 ET) works best for our team. I'll have the following people join:
- Susan Kim (PM)
- Mark Delgado (Eng lead) — mark.delgado@brightlinehealth.com
- Tom Ellis (Procurement) — included on this reply

We'll confirm if our security lead (Priya Rajan) can join — she might instead do a follow-up call.

One note on timing: our legal/procurement team prefers to be present for the initial discussion if there will be any contract milestones covered. Tom is looped in.

Can you send a calendar invite and meeting link (we use Zoom). Also please share any short pre-kickoff questionnaire so we can collect environment details ahead of time.

Best,

Quick heads-up from the SE side — I'll lead the product architecture section and want to ensure we cover the following technical checkpoints so Brightline can validate implementation readiness:

- Hosting model & data flow (public hosted vs private deployment)
- SSO / SCIM requirements and owners (please confirm who manages SSO on Brightline side)
- Network egress & IP allowlist questions
- Expected traffic profile & token volume estimates (bring any current forecasts)

Action: Susan / Mark — can you share primary SSO contact and whether you prefer SAML or OIDC? If no one can join on Thursday, we can do a focused SSO follow-up.

Also: we'll use the Zoom link Alex shared. If Brightline prefers a different provider, let us know and we'll re-issue the invite.

Thanks — Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
